function RunCap("'$exe,$arglist,$out,$err){ $p=Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $arglist -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -Wait -PassThru; return $p.ExitCode }
$cases=@(
  @('"'slice','--start','3','--end','1','tmp\\sel.csv'),
  @('frequency','--limit','0','--select','h1','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('frequency','--limit','0','--select','1','--no-headers','tmp\\freq.csv'),
  @('stats','--nulls','tmp\\statsq.csv'),
  @('stats','--median','tmp\\statsq.csv')
)
foreach("'$c in $cases){
  $name=($c -join '"'_') -replace '["'^A-Za-z0-9]'"','_'
  "'$e1=RunCap $ref $c "tmp'"\\r3_"'$name.out" "tmp'"\\r3_"'$name.err"; $e2=RunCap '"'.\\executable.cmd' "'$c "tmp'"\\p3_"'$name.out" "tmp'"\\p3_"'$name.err"
  $b1=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\r3_"'$name.out")); $b2=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\p3_"'$name.out")); $er1=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\r3_"'$name.err")); $er2=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path "tmp'"\\p3_"'$name.err"));
  $same=($e1 -eq $e2 -and [Convert]::ToBase64String($b1) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String($b2) -and [Convert]::ToBase64String($er1) -eq [Convert]::ToBase64String($er2))
  if($same){ "ok $($c -join '"' ')\" } else { \"FAIL "'$($c -join '"' ') exit "'$e1/$e2 len $($b1.Length)/$($b2.Length) err $($er1.Length)/$($er2.Length)"; '"'REF OUT:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\r3_"'$name.out"; '"'PY OUT:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\p3_"'$name.out"; '"'REF ERR:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\r3_"'$name.err"; '"'PY ERR:'; Get-Content -Raw \"tmp\\p3_"'$name.err" }
}'
